note: Cost of BUILDING each merged bundle (the merge step only). Evaluation cost is recorded separately, per method, when the bundles are scored. Methods 1 and 2 are deterministic scripts with no LLM call, so they have no token or dollar cost.

m1_order.wall_seconds_note: one run of build_merges.py, which builds m1 and m2 together; re-run 2026-10-21 and reproduced both bundles byte-identical

m2_nonconflict.wall_seconds_note: shared with m1_order: one script run builds both

m3_smart.builder: a fresh Claude Code subagent with no access to any score (merge_inputs/ only); it spawned 3 sub-agents (aap2; icinga; cost+babylon+security) and wrote orchestrator + shared_context itself
m3_smart.llm_tokens_note: the top-level merger agent's reported total only; the 3 sub-agents it spawned are not included, so this is a LOWER BOUND on the merge's token use
m3_smart.llm_usd_note: not reported by the subagent harness; tokens are not split into input/output/cache, so a dollar figure would be a guess
